title: Lifecycle playbook
description: An ordering of the venture development lifecycle, at packages/naive/src/functions/products/frameworks/product-anatomy/playbooks/<id>.json. The five phases, their questions and the set of frames are fixed; a playbook varies the order of decisions, which decisions gate which phase, and the evidence that clears each gate. A venture names its playbook in venture.json lifecycle_playbook (default product-first); packages/naive/src/engine/lifecycle.mjs reads the gate and its evidence from it. The founder chooses the playbook.

order.description: The broad order of moves the playbook takes

roadmaps.description: Decision roadmaps bundled with the playbook

gate.description: What clears the phase under this playbook

gating_decisions.description: Decision ids that must be decided before the gate passes

match.description: A case-insensitive pattern: a met exit criterion whose id, statement or evidence fits it supplies this evidence
